answer:
The naval figure who appears in every December entry of Samuel Pepys’ diary – from 1660 to 1667 – but is absent in the December 1668 entry is **Admiral Edward Montagu, later the 1st Earl of Sandwich**.

- The Facebook Q&A post *“Pepys Diary December Naval Figure Mentioned Every December Except December 1668”* explicitly states that Pepys “mention[s] his cousin Admiral Edward Montagu … in his diary every December from 1660 through 1667, but not in December 1668.” 【9†source】  
- Edward Montagu’s biography confirms that he was a naval officer who held the Admiralty position during those years, making him the most prominent naval figure in Pepys’ December pages. 【10†source】

Thus, the answer is Edward Montagu, the future 1st Earl of Sandwich.
